title: Detailed tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='leafGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7dff6b'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#2ecc40'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1a8c2a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='leafGrad2' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8ffb0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#5ee85a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#28a030'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='trunkGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8652a'/>
      <stop offset='30%' stop-color='#c8813a'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#b06e30'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a5018'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='groundGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5abe3c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a8a24'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='fruitGrad' cx='35%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9a9a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e83333'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81010'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='38' ry='7' fill='url(#groundGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#72d94f' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- trunk -->
  <path d='M44 90 Q43 78 42 68 Q41 58 40 50 L56 50 Q55 58 56 68 Q57 78 57 90 Z' fill='url(#trunkGrad)'/>
  <!-- trunk shading left -->
  <path d='M44 90 Q43 78 42 68 Q41 58 40 50 L46 50 Q46 58 46 68 Q45 78 46 90 Z' fill='#d89a50' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- trunk highlight -->
  <path d='M48 88 Q47.5 76 48 64 L51 64 Q50.5 76 51 88 Z' fill='#e8b870' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- bark lines -->
  <path d='M46 85 Q48 82 47 78' stroke='#7a4010' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M52 83 Q50 80 51 76' stroke='#7a4010' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M45 72 Q47 69 46 65' stroke='#7a4010' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M53 70 Q51 67 52 63' stroke='#7a4010' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- branches -->
  <path d='M43 55 Q35 50 30 44' stroke='#9a5a20' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 55 Q64 50 70 44' stroke='#9a5a20' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 62 Q36 58 30 54' stroke='#9a5a20' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 62 Q63 58 70 54' stroke='#9a5a20' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 50 Q46 42 44 36' stroke='#9a5a20' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 50 Q55 42 57 36' stroke='#9a5a20' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- canopy shadow layer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='36' ry='28' fill='#1a7a20'/>

  <!-- canopy main -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='38' rx='32' ry='25' fill='url(#leafGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='44' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#3db840'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='42' rx='22' ry='17' fill='#44cc44'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#58e050'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='32' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#68ee5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='34' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#4ed848'/>

  <!-- canopy lighter clusters -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='26' rx='14' ry='11' fill='url(#leafGrad2)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='24' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#8aff70'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='38' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#72f060'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='40' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#5ee050'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#b0ffa0'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='30' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#7af068'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='28' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#6ae858'/>

  <!-- leaf texture dots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#c8ffc0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='18' r='1.2' fill='#d8ffd0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='26' r='1.3' fill='#b8ffb0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#d0ffc8' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='36' r='1.1' fill='#c0ffb8' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='32' r='1.4' fill='#e0ffe0' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- fruits -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='30' r='3' fill='url(#fruitGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='28' r='2.8' fill='url(#fruitGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='url(#fruitGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='36' r='2.6' fill='url(#fruitGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='2.4' fill='url(#fruitGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='url(#fruitGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='url(#fruitGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='20' r='2' fill='url(#fruitGrad)'/>

  <!-- fruit highlights -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='29' r='0.9' fill='#ffd0d0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='27' r='0.8' fill='#ffd0d0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='37' r='0.7' fill='#ffd0d0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='35' r='0.7' fill='#ffd0d0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='19' r='0.7' fill='#ffd0d0' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- roots visible -->
  <path d='M44 90 Q38 92 34 94' stroke='#a8652a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 90 Q62 92 66 94' stroke='#a8652a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 91 Q42 94 40 96' stroke='#a8652a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 91 Q58 94 60 96' stroke='#a8652a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- grass tufts -->
  <path d='M20 92 Q22 86 24 92' stroke='#4ec838' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 92 Q78 86 80 92' stroke='#4ec838' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 94 Q32 89 34 94' stroke='#3ab82c' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 94 Q68 89 70 94' stroke='#3ab82c' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
